questions.prompt: How do you usually get your news?
questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, mostly I get my news online. I look at news websites, like, you know, the BBC. I don't read newspapers very much. It's easy to use the internet.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, actually, I don't really read newspapers that often. I tend to get my news online, from news websites or social media. I guess it's more convenient, and it's updated more frequently. So, yeah, mostly online.

questions.sampleBand8: Um, well, I primarily get my news from a variety of online sources. I have a few news apps on my phone, and I also follow several news organisations on social media. To be honest, I rarely buy physical newspapers anymore, although I do enjoy reading the weekend supplements every now and then. It's just more convenient to keep up with current events online.
questions.sampleBand9: Well, I'd say I'm a bit of a news junkie, so I consume it from various sources. I primarily rely on a curated selection of online news outlets and podcasts to stay abreast of current events. While I appreciate the in-depth analysis you can find in quality newspapers, I find the immediacy and accessibility of digital platforms ultimately more appealing. Plus, it's better for the environment, in the long run, I suppose.
questions.sampleAnswer: I've largely transitioned to a 'digital-first approach,' primarily utilizing a 'curated selection' of reputable news aggregates and independent journalistic platforms. I prefer the 'real-time updates' and the ability to cross-reference multiple 'perspectives on a single event' which digital media facilitates. However, I'm conscious of the risk of 'algorithmic bias,' so I make an effort to seek out 'contrarian viewpoints' to ensure I have a balanced 'geopolitical understanding.' It's about being an 'active consumer' of information rather than passively receiving a pre-packaged narrative.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, em, asosan yangiliklarni onlayn olaman. Yangiliklar veb-saytlariga qarayman, masalan, bilasiz, BBC. Gazetalarni unchalik ko'p o'qimayman. Internetdan foydalanish oson.

Onlayn orqali dolzarb voqealardan xabardor bo'lish shunchaki qulayroq.

Biroq, men 'algoritmik xatolik' xavfidan xabardorman, shuning uchun men 'qarama-qarshi nuqtai nazarlarni' qidirishga harakat qilaman, shunda men balanslangan 'geosiyosiy tushunchaga' ega bo'laman. questions.prompt: Do you think international news is important?
questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think it's, like, kind of important. I mean, it's good to know what's going on in other countries. It helps you, um, keep up with things. But, honestly, I don't always read it.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, yes, I'd say international news is fairly important. It's good to be aware of what's happening globally, not just in your own country. However, I don't actively seek it out. I mostly just see headlines online or something. It's good to stay informed.
questions.sampleBand7: Yes, I definitely think international news is important. It's crucial to have a broad understanding of global events, especially with how interconnected the world is these days. It allows you to form opinions on important issues and essentially, be a more informed citizen. Although, I must admit I don't always have the time to delve into it as much as I should.
questions.sampleBand8: Absolutely, international news is vital. In an increasingly globalized world, understanding events and issues beyond our own borders is absolutely essential. It helps us to understand different cultures and perspectives, and also allows us to engage with complex issues like climate change or international trade in a more meaningful way. Plus, it’s important to see the bigger picture and not just focus on local affairs. Generally speaking, it makes you a more well-rounded person.
questions.sampleBand9: Without a doubt, international news holds considerable importance. In our interconnected world, it's virtually impossible to ignore events unfolding beyond national boundaries. A strong grasp of international affairs is crucial for informed decision-making, fostering empathy across cultures, and addressing global challenges collaboratively. To be frank, a narrow focus on domestic issues runs the risk of provincialism. Furthermore, understanding global dynamics allows us to connect the dots and understand how seemingly distant events can impact our own lives, fostering a more nuanced and informed worldview. It's better to be safe than sorry, and in this case, being informed is being safe.
questions.sampleAnswer: Absolutely; in our 'hyper-integrated global economy,' I believe that maintaining a 'global consciousness' is a fundamental requirement for informed citizenship. What happens in a remote territory often has 'cascading effects' on local markets, supply chains, and political stability. Furthermore, international news provides a necessary 'comparative framework' that allows us to see our own domestic issues with greater 'objectivity and nuance.' It prevents us from becoming 'parochial' and helps foster a sense of 'interconnectedness'—an understanding that we are all part of a single, complex 'human narrative.' Ignoring the global picture is like trying to navigate a ship while only looking at the deck.

questions.uzSampleBand8: Albatta, xalqaro yangiliklar hayotiy muhim. Tobora globallashib borayotgan dunyoda, o'z chegaralarimizdan tashqaridagi voqealar va masalalarni tushunish mutlaqo zarur. Qolaversa, katta rasmni ko'rish va faqat mahalliy ishlarga e'tibor qaratmaslik muhim. Umuman olganda, bu sizni yanada har tomonlama rivojlangan insonga aylantiradi.

Xalqaro ishlar bo'yicha kuchli tushunchaga ega bo'lish xabardor qarorlar qabul qilish, turli madaniyatlar o'rtasida hamdardlikni rivojlantirish va global muammolarni hamkorlikda hal etish uchun juda muhimdir. questions.uzSampleAnswer: Albatta; bizning 'giper-integratsiyalashgan global iqtisodiyotimizda', menimcha, 'global ongni' saqlab turish xabardor fuqarolik uchun fundamental talabdir. Global manzaraga e'tibor bermaslik, kemani faqat palubaga qarab boshqarishga o'xshaydi.

questions.sampleBand9: I firmly believe that incorporating elements of fun into lessons is paramount for effective teaching. questions.sampleAnswer: I think 'fun' is a powerful 'catalyst for cognitive openness,' especially for younger learners, but it should never be at the 'expense of rigor.' Interaktiv mashg'ulotlar, real hayot misollari yoki hatto hazil orqali ta'limning o'ynoqi tomonini namoyon eta oladigan o'qituvchilar, asosan yanada rag'batlantiruvchi va foydali o'quv tajribasini yaratadilar. questions.prompt: Is it important for people to learn new skills all life long?

vocabulary.title: Q15 - Lifelong Learning
idioms: you can't teach an old dog new tricks (challenging this)

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think it's important. Learn new things is good. If you don't, you, um, fall behind. It's, um, like, for your job. Yes.
questions.sampleBand6: Yes, I think so. It's quite important actually. The world is always changing, and if you don't keep up with things, you might find it difficult. I mean, new skills can help you in your career and, well, life in general.
questions.sampleBand7: I definitely believe it's important. Obviously, the world is constantly evolving, and to remain competitive in the job market, you need to pick up new skills. Moreover, it's not just about work; learning keeps your mind active and can broaden your horizons. It's a win-win situation, really.
questions.sampleBand8: Absolutely, lifelong learning is crucial. Technology is advancing so rapidly that if you don't acquire new skills, you risk becoming obsolete. It's not just about career advancement either. Learning new things helps you stay engaged with the world, keeps you on your toes, and allows you to adapt to new challenges. Furthermore, it can be incredibly rewarding personally. It's a valuable asset.
questions.sampleBand9: Without a doubt, lifelong learning is paramount in today's rapidly evolving world. The sheer pace of technological advancement necessitates continuous upskilling and reskilling to remain competitive in the workforce. You can't teach an old dog new tricks, so it's important to stay ahead of the curve. Beyond career prospects, it's a matter of personal enrichment and intellectual stimulation. Actively engaging with new ideas and skills fosters adaptability, resilience, and a growth mindset, all of which are essential for navigating the complexities of modern life. In the grand scheme of things, it's about maximizing your potential and living a more fulfilling life.
questions.sampleAnswer: I consider 'lifelong learning' to be the single most important 'strategic asset' an individual can possess in the 21st century. We are living through an era of 'exponential technological change' where the half-life of a technical skill is shrinking rapidly. Beyond the 'economic imperative' of staying employable, continuous learning is a 'biological safeguard' against 'cognitive stagnation.' It provides a 'constant sense of agency' and prevents the 'mental atrophy' that can occur later in life. Furthermore, a commitment to 'perpetual growth' ensures that our 'internal narrative' remains one of 'possibility rather than decline.' To stop learning is to effectively stop 'participating' in the evolution of human society.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Hm, menimcha bu muhim. Yangi narsalarni o'rganish yaxshi. Agar qilmasangiz, siz, hm, ortda qolasiz. Bu, hm, ishingiz uchun kerak bo'ladi. Ha.

questions.uzSampleBand7: Men, albatta, bu muhim deb hisoblayman. Albatta, dunyo doim rivojlanib bormoqda, ish bozorida raqobatbardosh bo'lib qolish uchun siz yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganishingiz kerak. Bundan tashqari, bu faqat ish haqida emas; o'rganish miyangizni faol saqlaydi va dunyoqarashingizni kengaytirishi mumkin. Bu haqiqatan ham ikki tomon uchun ham foydali vaziyat.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Albatta, hayot davomida o'rganish juda muhim. Texnologiya shunchalik tez rivojlanmoqdaki, agar siz yangi ko'nikmalarni egallamasangiz, eskirib qolish xavfi bor. Bu faqat karyera o'sishi haqida emas. Yangi narsalarni o'rganish sizga dunyo bilan aloqada bo'lishga, hushyor bo'lishga va yangi qiyinchiliklarga moslashishga yordam beradi. Bundan tashqari, bu shaxsan juda foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Bu qimmatli aktiv.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Shubhasiz, hayot davomida o'rganish bugungi tez rivojlanayotgan dunyoda eng muhimdir. Texnologik taraqqiyotning juda tez sur'ati ishchi kuchida raqobatbardosh bo'lib qolish uchun doimiy malaka oshirish va qayta tayyorlashni talab qiladi. Qarigan itga yangi hiylalar o'rgata olmaysiz, shuning uchun oldingi saflarda bo'lish muhim. Karyera istiqbollaridan tashqari, bu shaxsiy boyitish va intellektual rag'batlantirish masalasidir. Yangi g'oyalar va ko'nikmalar bilan faol shug'ullanish moslashuvchanlikni, chidamlilikni va o'sish fikrlashini rivojlantiradi, bularning barchasi zamonaviy hayotning murakkabliklarini boshqarish uchun zarurdir. Umuman olganda, bu sizning potentsialingizni maksimal darajada oshirish va yanada mazmunli hayot kechirish haqida.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Menimcha, 'hayot davomida o'rganish' 21-asrda shaxs ega bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan eng muhim 'strategik aktiv'dir. Biz 'ekspotensial texnologik o'zgarishlar' davrini boshdan kechirmoqdamiz, bunda texnik mahoratning yarim umri tez qisqarmoqda. Ish bilan ta'minlanganlikning 'iqtisodiy zaruriyatidan' tashqari, doimiy o'rganish 'kognitiv turg'unlikka' qarshi 'biologik himoya'dir. U 'doimiy agentlik tuyg'usini' ta'minlaydi va hayotning keyingi davrida yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan 'aqliy atrofiyani' oldini oladi. Bundan tashqari, 'doimiy o'sish'ga sodiqlik bizning 'ichki hikoyamiz' 'pasayishdan ko'ra imkoniyat' haqida bo'lishini ta'minlaydi. O'rganishni to'xtatish - insoniyat jamiyatining evolyutsiyasida 'ishtirok etishni' to'xtatish bilan barobar.

questions.prompt: Do you think enterprises should provide training for their employees?
questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think it's quite important. If they want their employees to do a good job. Basically, training can help. It's, um, good for business, I think.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, yes, I think it's a good idea. Actually, if companies invest in training, employees can pick up new skills. And, well, that helps the company in the long run. I think it's beneficial for everyone.
questions.sampleBand7: Yes, I definitely think companies should provide training. It's beneficial particularly in today's fast-paced world where technology is constantly evolving. Employees need to keep up with the latest developments, and training is essential for that. Moreover, it shows employees that they are valued, which can boost morale and productivity.
questions.sampleBand8: I firmly believe that enterprises should invest in employee training, absolutely. It's not just about improving skills; it's about fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Furthermore, providing training opportunities enhances employee engagement and reduces turnover. If employees feel they are developing professionally, they are more likely to remain loyal to the company. On top of that, a well-trained workforce gives a company a significant competitive advantage.
questions.sampleBand9: Without a doubt, enterprises have a responsibility to provide comprehensive training for their employees. In today's rapidly changing global landscape, ongoing professional development is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. Companies that fall behind in this area risk becoming obsolete. Indeed, investing in employee training is an investment in the company's future. It's a win-win situation; employees acquire valuable skills, and the company benefits from a more skilled and motivated workforce. Ultimately, a rising tide lifts all boats, and a well-trained workforce strengthens the entire economy.
questions.sampleAnswer: I believe that 'employer-sponsored training' is one of the most 'mutually beneficial investments' a company can make; it's a 'win-win scenario' for both the 'bottom line' and 'employee retention.' For the enterprise, it ensures a 'future-proof workforce' that can adapt to 'emerging industry shifts' without expensive external hiring. For the employee, it signals that they are 'valued as a long-term asset,' which massively boosts 'morale and loyalty.' Furthermore, in a 'knowledge-based economy,' the 'collective brainpower' of a company's workforce is its primary 'competitive advantage.' Companies that view training as a 'sunk cost' rather than a 'capital investment' are essentially 'planning for their own obsolescence.' It's about 'mutualizing the risk' of technological progress.

questions.uzSampleBand6: Hm, ha, menimcha bu yaxshi fikr. Aslida, agar kompaniyalar treningga sarmoya kiritsa, xodimlar yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganib olishlari mumkin. Va, hm, bu kompaniyaga uzoq muddatda yordam beradi. Menimcha, bu hamma uchun foydali.

Bundan tashqari, yaxshi tayyorlangan ishchi kuchi kompaniyaga sezilarli raqobatbardosh ustunlik beradi.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Shubhasiz, korxonalar o'z xodimlari uchun keng qamrovli treninglar o'tkazishga mas'uldirlar.
